checks.claim: Spanish public subsidies are governed by Ley 38/2003 and its implementing regulation, subject to each call's specific rules
Real Decreto 887/2006 implements Ley 38/2003 and applies alongside the specific regulatory bases of each subsidy
The BDNS/Sistema Nacional de Publicidad de Subvenciones is part of the statutory publication system for calls and awards
The general EU de minimis ceiling under Regulation 2023/2831 is 300,000 EUR per single undertaking over any three-year period
De minimis assessment must account for the definition of a single undertaking, including control relationships between companies
Eligibility, deadlines, eligible costs, award criteria, justification and reimbursement conditions must be checked against the live call and its regulatory bases

limitations: This validates suitability as a maintained subsidy/advisory knowledge source, not every call or sentence exhaustively.
Calls, budgets, eligible costs, deadlines, de minimis accumulation, sector exclusions and territorial rules are dynamic and must be rechecked live before advice or submission.
Submission, declarations, signatures, acceptance of obligations and reimbursement litigation remain subject to legal/human gates where applicable.
